items.title: Johnny Varro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And sure enough I went with him. We played the Grandview Inn, we played the Blue Note in Chicago, we played some great rooms. And while we’re playing Bobby is teaching me songs and instructing me

ctx.x: I see you served in Korea in the service.

Yeah. I was there from ’51 through ’53. No I was in Korea for all of ’52 that is. I took — I was a radio operator. And I went over there and did radio. And when I got out I sat home and it was like March of ’53. And I’m sitting home and I’m not knowing what to do with myself. And the phone rings. And, “Hello?” “Hi, Johnny, this is Bobby Hackett.” Very serious. Bobby Hackett, oh my God, I loved him, I mean he was somebody I admired all my life. His knowledge of music, his knowledge of chords and everything, it was…
